description.zh:
是否强制切换主备实例。取值范围：

- **true**：表示强制切换主备实例。

- **false**：表示不强制切换主备实例。
description.en:
Whether to force the switchover.
- true: Force the switchover.
- false: Do not force the switchover.

description.zh: 主备实例 ID，默认可以使用需要切换为主实例的实例 ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the primary/standby instance. You can set the default value to the instance ID of the instance to be switched to the primary instance.

description.zh: 需要切换为主实例的实例 ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the instance to be switched to the primary instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro switchover-instance --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --target-instance-id ob4bv8o7sp0000 --forced true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro SwitchoverInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --TargetInstanceId ob4bv8o7sp0000 --Forced true
